public-home.name: Browse home content
public-home.description: Navigate to home and view featured categories, trending products, and diary cards.

public-about.name: View About page
public-about.description: Open the About page from site navigation and read its localized content.

public-terms.name: View terms
public-terms.description: Open the localized terms page and return to the site.

public-privacy.name: View privacy policy
public-privacy.description: Open the localized privacy policy from navigation or authentication pages.

public-contact-submit.name: Submit contact form
public-contact-submit.description: Submit a valid contact message or receive validation and service-failure feedback.

public-faq-toggle.name: Browse FAQ answers
public-faq-toggle.description: Expand and collapse FAQ answers on the home page.

navigation-locale-switch.name: Switch locale
navigation-locale-switch.description: Switch English and Spanish while preserving the current route.

navigation-mobile-menu.name: Use mobile navigation
navigation-mobile-menu.description: Open the mobile menu and navigate to a public destination.

navigation-not-found.name: View not-found page
navigation-not-found.description: Visit an unknown route and use the recoverable not-found view.

auth-register.name: Register account
auth-register.description: Create an account or receive client/server validation and delivery-failure feedback.

auth-verify-email.name: Verify email
auth-verify-email.description: Activate a pending account with a valid code or receive rejected-code and request-failure feedback.

auth-resend-verification.name: Resend verification code
auth-resend-verification.description: Request a replacement verification code, including rejected and delivery-failure states.

auth-login.name: Log in
auth-login.description: Authenticate a verified user or display rejected credentials and request failures.

auth-forgot-password.name: Request password reset
auth-forgot-password.description: Request a reset code with valid input or display validation and delivery failures.

auth-reset-code.name: Validate reset code locally
auth-reset-code.description: Enter a four-digit reset code and continue to password reset, or display local validation feedback.

auth-reset-password.name: Reset password
auth-reset-password.description: Set a new password using a valid code or display rejected-field and request-failure feedback.

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protect authenticated routes
auth-protected-redirect.description: Redirect an unauthenticated visitor from profile routes to login.

auth-guest-redirect.name: Protect guest routes
auth-guest-redirect.description: Redirect an authenticated user away from login and signup.

auth-logout.name: Log out
auth-logout.description: Clear authenticated state from the profile navigation and return to a public route.

catalog-browse.name: Browse catalog
catalog-browse.description: Navigate to the catalog and view real products or its loading failure state.

catalog-filter-sort.name: Filter and sort catalog
catalog-filter-sort.description: Select themes or categories, sort products, paginate, and handle loading failures.

catalog-search.name: Search catalog
catalog-search.description: Search products and display matching, empty, or request-failure states.

catalog-product-detail.name: View product detail
catalog-product-detail.description: Open a product and view its price, stock, gallery, description, and unavailable or failed detail states.

catalog-product-variation.name: Select product variation
catalog-product-variation.description: Select attributes for a variable product and handle incomplete, unavailable, and load-failure combinations.

catalog-trending-navigation.name: Browse trending products
catalog-trending-navigation.description: View trending products, open a listed product, and retry a failed content load.

catalog-favorite-product.name: Favorite product
catalog-favorite-product.description: Add or remove a product favorite and show current state, authorization, or service failure.

cart-remove.name: Remove cart item

cart-clear.name: Clear cart
cart-clear.description: Confirm cart clearing and display the resulting empty state.

checkout-shipping-details.name: Enter shipping details
checkout-shipping-details.description: Enter recipient and shipping data with client, server, and dependency validation.

checkout-discount.name: Apply discount
checkout-discount.description: Apply a valid discount or display rejected and service-unavailable states.

checkout-wompi.name: Pay with Wompi

checkout-payment-status.name: View payment result

checkout-gift-recipient.name: Checkout a gift

wishlist-create.name: Create wishlist
wishlist-create.description: Create a named wishlist and report validation or service errors.

wishlist-direct-gift.name: Gift from shared wishlist
wishlist-direct-gift.description: Select a public wishlist and enter gift checkout for its owner.

wishlist-public-search.name: Search public wishlists
wishlist-public-search.description: Search a username, display public wishlists or no results, and open a selected list for gift checkout.

wishlist-copy-share-link.name: Copy wishlist share link
wishlist-copy-share-link.description: Copy an owned or public wishlist URL and show successful or failed clipboard feedback.

profile-dashboard.name: View profile dashboard

profile-crush-verification.description: Request or cancel crush verification and display current pending, approved, or rejected status.

profile-favorites.name: Manage favorite products
profile-favorites.description: View and remove favorite products, including empty and loading-failure states.

profile-order-history.name: View order history
profile-order-history.description: View real purchase history, expand orders, paginate, and open a purchased product.

profile-gifts.name: View sent and received gifts
profile-gifts.description: Switch between sent and received gift records and view real or empty states.

profile-feed.name: View profile activity feed
profile-feed.description: View activity feed records or the empty and load-failure states on the dashboard.

diaries-random-crush.name: Discover a random crush
diaries-random-crush.description: Load a random verified crush profile and retry a failed load.

diaries-public-profile.name: View crush public profile

diaries-user-search.name: Search crush profiles
diaries-user-search.description: Search public profiles, select a result, or display empty and request-failure states.

admin-login.name: Log in to Django admin
admin-login.description: Authenticate a staff user in the custom Django admin or reject invalid credentials and failures.

admin-order-management.name: Manage order status
admin-order-management.description: Find an order, view it, and update operational status from Django Admin.

admin-crush-verification.name: Review crush verification
admin-crush-verification.description: Review, approve, or reject pending crush verification requests from Django Admin.

admin-user-management.name: Manage user records
admin-user-management.description: Search, inspect, and update registered user, guest, address, gallery, and link records in Django Admin.

admin-catalog-management.name: Manage catalog records
admin-catalog-management.description: Search, inspect, and update local catalog, WooCommerce mirror, category, variation, and pricing-margin records.

admin-discount-management.name: Manage discount codes
admin-discount-management.description: Create, edit, inspect, or reject invalid discount-code changes in Django Admin.
